INSERT INTO TB_QUESTION ( QUESTION_ID, MEMBER_ID, CASE_ID, TITLE, CONTENT, CASE_TYPE, STATUS, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{questionId}, #{memberId}, #{caseId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{caseType}, 'OPEN', SYSDATE, SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT q.QUESTION_ID, q.MEMBER_ID, m.NAME AS MEMBER_NAME, q.TITLE, q.CASE_TYPE, q.STATUS, q.CREATED_AT, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_ANSWER a WHERE a.QUESTION_ID = q.QUESTION_ID) AS ANSWER_COUNT FROM TB_QUESTION q LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_MEMBER m ON q.MEMBER_ID = m.MEMBER_ID ORDER BY q.CREATED_AT DESC

SELECT q.QUESTION_ID, q.MEMBER_ID, qm.NAME as MEMBER_NAME, q.CASE_ID, q.TITLE, q.CONTENT, q.CASE_TYPE, q.ASSIGNED_LAWYER, q.STATUS, q.CREATED_AT, q.UPDATED_AT, a.ANSWER_ID, a.CONTENT as ANSWER_CONTENT, a.CREATED_AT as ANSWER_CREATED_AT, a.LAWYER_ID, a.IS_ADOPTED, m.NAME as LAWYER_NAME FROM TB_QUESTION q LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_MEMBER qm ON q.MEMBER_ID = qm.MEMBER_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_ANSWER a ON q.QUESTION_ID = a.QUESTION_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_LAWYER l ON a.LAWYER_ID = l.LAWYER_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_MEMBER m ON l.MEMBER_ID = m.MEMBER_ID WHERE q.QUESTION_ID = #{questionId} ORDER BY a.CREATED_AT DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_QUESTION SET STATUS = #{status}, UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE QUESTION_ID = #{questionId}
UPDATE TB_QUESTION SET ASSIGNED_LAWYER = #{lawyerId}, STATUS = 'ADOPTED', UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE QUESTION_ID = #{questionId} AND MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} -- 본인 확인 (보안 강화)
UPDATE TB_ANSWER SET IS_ADOPTED = 'Y' WHERE ANSWER_ID = #{answerId}
